sections.title: Applied Physiology for Nurse Anesthesia III
sections.description: This course provides an in-depth analysis of the anatomy, physiology and pathophysiology of the neurological, gastrointestinal, and endocrine systems with a focus on anesthesia implications. Emphasis is placed on the assessment of the patient with common disorders of these systems.
